Removed the unwarranted inherited assertion and required explicit isolated production tools probe instead. No earlier run was retroactively promoted.
First Ruff run found import-order and E731 lambda style findings; fixed. Later test-cache-rebuild edit added one import-order finding, then fixed.
live_api: No API or remote operations performed by this implementation agent. Parent owns two-host deployment and explicit live tests; their receipts are separate evidence.
limitations: The provider canary covers manual AskRyn history, not preexisting provider Agent assistant history. No provider Agent task is fabricated to fill that gap.
Two queued sessions do not establish concurrency or interleaving; actual tool rounds, histories and marker isolation must be inspected from raw events.
Manual sharing with Agent toggled, unauthorized/revoked/cross-model denials, disconnect/reconnect, followup and real process persistence remain live scenario checks, not unit-test claims.
Provider source hash covers sources.enc only, not every owner file. Configuration stability outside this scope requires separate evidence.
Python code hashes and host/process metadata are observed software identity evidence, not hardware attestation. Direct LAN must be supported by both physical hosts and actual endpoint receipts.
Peer wire captures cap at 2 MiB each and explicitly mark truncation. Semantic judgments and claims outside captured scope are manual-review requirements.
Legacy infer_stream is deliberately unavailable; production Agent structured chat remains enabled. This does not demonstrate every transport or manual legacy streaming mode.
No formal model/tool preregistration envelope or activated acceptance grade is emitted.
